name: @google-cloud/adapter-nextjs
description: Google Cloud Run deployment adapter for Next.js

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/serve/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=cjs --outfile=dist/serve.js
scripts.test:smoke: npm run build && SMOKE_TEST=1 ts-mocha --timeout 120000 -p tsconfig.json 'src/**/*.{spec,test}.ts'
